Name: Bathroom after 2nd Houseupgrade
Author: DevilBro
Description:
Works with Stardew Valley 1.1

This mod adds a bathroom in your house once you upgraded it to level 2.
You can bath in your own little pool and recover stamina.
Everything else is just cosmetic. 

Unzip the zip and add the files/folders into your Content folder.

This mod will not "work" with other mods that change the level 2 farmhouse,
because it will overwritte any other mods that uses the mapfile of the level 2 farmhouse.

Known bugs: the interaction with the mirror has the same dialog as the interaction with the shrine of illusions,
sadly I can not change this, since it seems that the dialog is hardcoded.


Advancement: If you are looking for an update version without the crib and/or the kidbeds, check out 
http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/369/ Note: You will have to install my mod first and then update to the kidfree version.
